content: Dr. Zia Lazzerini serves as the Director of the Department of Paediatrics and the Unit of Research on Health Services and International Health at the Institute for Maternal and Child Health in Italy. Her expertise includes paediatrics, malnutrition, infectious diseases, and research methodologies. Dr. Guansheng Ma is a Professor and Deputy Director at the National Institute for Nutrition and Food Safety, part of the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention in China. His areas of specialization include food safety, public health, and programme management. Dr. Mahdi Ramsan Mohamed is the Chief of Party at RTI International in the United Republic of Tanzania, with a focus on malaria. Professor Malcolm E. Molyneux is a Senior Scientist at the Malawi-Liverpool-Wellcome Trust Clinical Research Programme in Malawi. His expertise lies in malaria and research on international tropical diseases. Dr. Lynnette Neufeld is the Director of Monitoring, Learning, and Research at the Global Alliance for Improved Nutrition in Switzerland. Her work focuses on micronutrients, programme development, and epidemiology. Professor Orish Ebere Orisakwe is a Professor of Pharmacology and Toxicology in the Department of Experimental Pharmacology and Toxicology at the University of Port Harcourt in Nigeria. His expertise includes pharmacology, food safety, and toxicology. Dr. Mical Paul is an Associate Professor at the Technion-Israel Institute of Technology in Israel, specializing in infectious diseases and HIV. Engineer Wisam Qarqash is a Senior Education and Curriculum Development Specialist in Jordan, focusing on the design, implementation, and evaluation of health communication programmes. Professor Dalip Ragoobirsingh is the Director of the Diabetes Education Programme at the University of the West Indies in Jamaica, with expertise in diabetes. Dr. Daniel J. Raiten is a Programme Officer at the Office of Prevention Research and International Programs, Center for Research for Mothers and Children, United States. His work focuses on micronutrients, programme development, and infant feeding. Dr. Héctor Bourges Rodríguez is the Director of Nutrition at the Instituto Nacional de Ciencias Médicas y Nutrición Salvador Zubirán in Mexico. His expertise includes nutritional biochemistry, metabolism research, food programmes, policy, and regulations. Professor Harshpal Singh Sachdev is a Senior Consultant in Paediatrics and Clinical Epidemiology at the Sitaram Bhartia Institute of Science and Research in India. His work focuses on paediatrics and systematic reviews. Ms. Rusidah Selamat is the Deputy Director of Operations in the Nutrition Division at the Ministry of Health in Malaysia, specializing in public health nutrition. Dr. Rebecca Joyce Stoltzfus is a Professor and Director of the Program in International Nutrition and the Program in Global Health at the Division of Nutritional Sciences, Cornell University, United States. Her expertise includes international nutrition, public health, and research on iron and vitamin A nutrition. Dr. Kalid Asrat Tasew is a Consultant Paediatrician at St. Paul’s Hospital Millennium Medical College in Ethiopia, specializing in paediatrics. Dr. Carol Tom is a Regional Food Fortification Adviser for the A2Z Project in East, Central, and Southern Africa, based in the United Republic of Tanzania. Her expertise includes food fortification, technical regulations, standards, and policy harmonization. Dr. Igor Veljkovik is a Health and Nutrition Officer at UNICEF in Skopje, North Macedonia, focusing on programme implementation. Dr. Maged Younes is an independent international expert on global public health based in Italy, with expertise in food safety, public health, and programme management. Dr. Huda Al Hourani is an Associate Professor in the Department of Clinical Nutrition and Dietetics at the Hashemite University in Jordan. Her work focuses on nutrition counseling, chronic diseases, and noncommunicable diseases. Dr. Beverly-Ann Biggs is the Head of the International and Immigrant Health Group in the Department of Medicine at the University of Melbourne, Australia. Her expertise includes micronutrient supplementation and clinical infectious diseases. Professor Nilanthi de Silva is a Professor of Parasitology and Dean of the Faculty of Medicine at the University of Kelaniya in Sri Lanka. Her work focuses on medical parasitology and neglected tropical diseases. Ms. Claudia Lema Dodobara is the Executive Director of Salud Sin Límites in Peru, specializing in medical anthropology and qualitative health research. Professor Anbrasi Edward is an Associate Scientist at the Center for Refugee and Disaster Studies, Department of International Health, Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, United States. Her expertise includes health systems and community-based research. Professor Serge Paul Eholié is a Professor of Tropical and Infectious Diseases at Treichville University Teaching Hospital in Côte d’Ivoire. His work focuses on HIV, infectious diseases, and noncommunicable diseases. Professor Heba El Laithy is a Professor of Statistics at the Faculty of Economics and Political Science, Cairo University, Egypt. Her expertise includes social impact evaluation and micro-data analysis. Dr. Fiona Fleming is a Senior Monitoring and Evaluation Manager at the Faculty of Medicine, School of Public Health, Imperial College London, United Kingdom. Her work focuses on the control of infectious diseases and neglected tropical diseases. Professor Theresa Gyorkos is a Professor in the Department of Epidemiology, Biostatistics, and Occupational Health at McGill University, Canada. Her expertise includes global health, parasite disease epidemiology, and neglected tropical diseases. Professor Celia Holland is a Professor of Parasitology at the School of Natural Sciences, Trinity College Dublin, United Kingdom. Her work focuses on the epidemiology and control of soil-transmitted helminths. Dr. Narcis Kabatereine is the Head of the Vector Control Division at the Ministry of Health in Uganda, specializing in the control of neglected tropical diseases. Ms. Monica Muti is a Nutrition Intervention Manager at the Ministry of Health and Child Welfare in Zimbabwe, focusing on nutrition and national implementation programmes. Professor Malden Nesheim is a Professor Emeritus in the Division of Nutritional Sciences at Cornell University, United States. His expertise includes nutrition and the nutritional consequences of neglected tropical diseases. Ms. Ifeoma Uzoamaka Onoja is a Principal Dietitian at the University of Nigeria Teaching Hospital in Nigeria, specializing in nutrition, dietetics, and infant and maternal healthcare. Dr. Teck Chuan Voo is an Assistant Professor at the Centre for Biomedical Ethics, National University of Singapore, Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine, Singapore. His expertise includes research ethics and clinical ethics. Dr. Camila Chaparro is an international nutrition consultant based in the United States. Dr. Andrew Hall is a Senior Nutrition Advisor at Save the Children in the United Kingdom. Dr. Sonja Yvonne Hess is affiliated with the Department of Nutrition at the University of California, United States. Dr. Rafael Perez-Escamilla is a Professor of Epidemiology and Public Health and Director at Yale School of Public Health, United States. Mr. Arnold Timmer is a Senior Adviser on Micronutrients at UNICEF, United States. Dr. David Tovey is the Editor-in-Chief of The Cochrane Library, United Kingdom. Dr. Michael Zimmermann is the Head of the Human Nutrition Laboratory at the Institute of Food, Nutrition, and Health, Swiss Federal Institute of Technology (ETH), Switzerland. Dr. Theodore Bailey is a Postdoctoral Fellow at the Johns Hopkins Berman Institute of Bioethics, Bloomberg School of Public Health, United States. Dr. Kevin Croke is an Economist at the World Bank and a Visiting Scientist at the Harvard School of Public Health, United States. Dr. Mathew Freeman is an Assistant Professor at the Rollins School of Public Health, Emory University, United States. Dr. Serene Aimee Joseph is affiliated with the Swiss Tropical and Public Health Institute, Switzerland. Dr. Peter Jourdan is part of the Faculty of Medicine, School of Public Health, Imperial College London, United Kingdom. Ms. Rehana A. Salam is an Assistant Professor at Aga Khan University and the University of Adelaide, Australia. Dr. David D. Taylor-Robinson is a Senior Clinical Lecturer in Public Health at the Department of Public Health and Policy, University of Liverpool, United Kingdom. Dr. Hugo C. Turner is a Research Associate at the Faculty of Medicine, School of Public Health, Imperial College London, United Kingdom. Dr. Vivian Andrea Welch is the Deputy Director at the Centre for Global Health, Bruyère Research Institute, Canada.
